title: Reconstruction from heap paths
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb{N}$ with $k\le n$, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Assembling the two heap-path indices of $x$, computed on the first $n-k$ and last $k$ coordinates respectively, recovers $x$.
